keys.title: Keyboard
keys.meeting: space play or pause · [ ] previous or next line · e edit line · s next speaker

list.title: Meetings
list.empty_body: recall starts recording on its own when a meeting app uses your microphone.

meeting.delete_confirm: Delete “{title}” with its audio and transcript? This cannot be undone.

summary.title: Summary
summary.pending: The summary appears when processing finishes.

ask.title: Ask this meeting
ask.intro: Ask about what was said. Answers come from this meeting's transcript.
ask.placeholder: What did we decide about the budget?
ask.failed: Could not get an answer. Check that the language model is running.

people.title: People
people.intro: Everyone recall has recognised by voice. Rename someone to fix their name in every meeting, or merge two entries that are the same person.
people.edit_hint: Click a name to rename it. Enter saves, Esc cancels.
people.me_no_merge: Your own entry cannot be merged
people.merge_confirm: Merge “{from}” into “{into}”? Their voice samples and meeting lines move to “{into}”. This cannot be undone.
people.empty_body: People appear here after recall hears them in a meeting and you name them in the transcript.

settings.title: Settings
settings.restart_required: Saved. Restart the recall daemon to apply the changes.
settings.meetings_dir_help: Absolute path where each meeting gets its own folder with audio, transcript and notes.
settings.data_dir_help: Absolute path for the speaker registry, search index and models.
settings.record_screen_help: Saves a screen recording next to the audio.
settings.allowlist_help: recall records when one of these apps uses the microphone. Press Enter or comma to add.
settings.debounce_secs_help: How long an app must hold the microphone before recording starts.
settings.end_grace_secs_help: How long to keep recording after the microphone is released.
settings.stt_engine_help: The local model that turns speech into text.
settings.llm_model_help: For Ollama, a model you have pulled, such as qwen3.6:35b-a3b.
settings.summary_lang_help: Language of summaries, decisions and action items.
settings.ui_lang_help: Changes right away in this browser; saving also stores it in the config.
settings.err_seconds: Enter a whole number of seconds, 0 or more.
settings.err_threads: Enter a whole number from 1 to 256.
settings.err_absolute: Enter an absolute path, starting with /.

selftest.help: Records {n} seconds from the microphone and the system audio. Play something and say a few words.
selftest.ok: Both tracks have sound. Recording works.
selftest.sys_silent: No system audio captured. Check that something was playing and that recall can read the output monitor.
selftest.mic_silent: The microphone is silent. Check the input device and that it is not muted.
selftest.both_silent: Both tracks are silent. Check the microphone and that something was playing.
